type.title: What kind of event is it?
type.description: We'll fill in typical dates and tickets for it. You can change all of them.
type.switchConfirm: Changing the event type clears the tickets you've set up. Change it anyway?
type.required: Pick an event type before saving a draft

Workshop.title: Workshop
Workshop.description: Classes, usually with a party at night

title.title: What's the event called?
title.description: Shown on the registration page, the share link and the confirmation email.
title.label: Event name
title.required: Give the event a name before saving a draft

dates.title: When is it?
dates.description: Taiwan time. Pick a common one, then adjust.
dates.invalid: The end has to be after the start
dates.hint: The dates are also used to fill in Day Passes and early-bird deadlines.

location.title: Where is it?
location.description: Pick a saved venue or add a new one. Haven't booked one yet? You can fill this in later.
location.savedHint: Saved to your saved info, so you can pick it next time.
location.skipped: You skipped this step. Add a venue before publishing — the finish step and the event page will remind you.

cover.title: Add a cover image?
cover.description: Shown when the link is shared on Instagram or LINE. You can publish without one.
cover.hint: 16:9 recommended · up to 4MB · or drag it here

description.title: Tell people about the event
description.description: Not sure what to write? Tap a section below — it's formatted for you, just change the words.

teachers.label: Teachers
teachers.text:
## Teachers
[Teacher name] — [a line or two about them]

notices.label: Notices
notices.text:
## Notices
- Bring dance shoes
- No refunds after registering, but tickets can be transferred

transport.label: Getting there
transport.text:
## Getting there
[Nearest MRT station], [n] minutes on foot

organizer.title: Who's organizing it?
organizer.description: The registration page shows the organizer and their Instagram, so people know who to ask.

payment.title: How do registrants pay?
payment.description: Registrants upload a screenshot after transferring, you confirm it in the dashboard, and they get a confirmation email.
payment.bankQuestion: Which account do they transfer to?
payment.addLinePayeeDescription: Name, LINE ID or add-friend link
payment.skipped: You skipped this step. Set a bank account before publishing, or registrants won't know where to pay.

tickets.title: Which tickets will you sell?
tickets.description: The ticket wizard sets up Full Passes, Day Passes, single classes and early-bird prices, one question at a time. About 2 minutes.
tickets.emptyDescription: Answers are pre-filled for a {type} on these dates — you just check the prices.
tickets.doneTitle: {count, plural, one {# ticket type set up} other {# ticket types set up}}
tickets.editLater: After creating the event you can change them any time under Tickets.
tickets.skipped: You skipped this step. Set up tickets before publishing so registrants have something to buy.

review.readyDescription: Publish now, or save a draft for your team to look over first.
review.missingDescription: Save a draft for now and come back once the venue and account are settled.

answers.tickets: {count, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} · from {price}

preview.subtitle: Grows as you fill it in
